name: Rose Medical
old_description: Rose Medical specializes in crafting high-quality cannulas, catheters, and custom medical devices, offering a comprehensive range of manufacturing capabilities:
about:
Rose Medical operates from Grand Rapids, Michigan, where it was founded in 1998 as Rose Technologies. The company began by building manufacturing and quality-assurance testing equipment for medical devices before securing its first production contract in 2000 and moving to its current facility three years later.

Today the firm is a full-service medical device contract manufacturer specializing in catheters and finished devices. Its in-house capabilities span tip forming, wire-reinforced cannulas, balloon fabrication, injection and silicone molding, dip molding, PTFE forming, laser processing, assembly, sterile barrier packaging, and CNC machining for custom automation equipment. Two sites house multiple ISO Class 7 cleanrooms, supporting vertical integration from concept through validation.

Rose Medical serves the cardiovascular, neurovascular, robotic surgery, gastrointestinal, and minimally invasive surgery markets. Its customer base includes major original equipment manufacturers as well as tier 2 and tier 3 suppliers.

The company emphasizes vertical integration to deliver speed to market, seamless communication via a dedicated project engineer, and guaranteed consistency through a quality culture that cross-trains every employee on critical quality principles.

The business presents itself as a custom upholstery and furniture manufacturing shop serving the greater Connecticut area.

The shop provides a range of furniture services: reassembly of broken pieces with re-gluing, reinforcement of frames including spring and webbing replacement, and full reupholstery with new fabric and padding. name: Rosti North Carolina
old_description: Partner in Precision Plastic Injection Moulding and Contract Manufacturing
about:
Rosti North Carolina operates from Cary, North Carolina, as part of the Rosti Group, a global plastic injection moulding and contract manufacturing company founded in 1944. The group has grown to 13 manufacturing sites across Europe, Asia, and North America, with the North Carolina location serving as a strategic hub for the Americas.

The facility provides precision plastic injection moulding, including multi-material moulding, high-volume production, and complex geometry capabilities. It also offers ISO-classified cleanroom manufacturing for medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostics, along with integrated automation and assembly, robotic handling, automated inspection, and toolmaking with rapid sampling and pilot production. The company emphasizes scalable production models that span from early prototypes to multi-site, full-scale manufacturing.

Rosti serves OEMs in medical and life sciences, automotive and e-mobility, consumer and home appliances, industrial and professional equipment, and filtration, optics, and high-performance components. Its cleanroom capabilities and ISO 13485 certification make it a partner for regulated medical and diagnostic production.

The company differentiates itself through over 80 years of manufacturing heritage, a global footprint, and sustainability commitments that include 100 percent clean energy at all sites, a 2030 emissions reduction roadmap, and circular design principles. An on-site Innovation & Sustainability Centre supports material optimization and energy-efficient tooling.

Rountree Electric Supply Co. operates from Selma, Alabama, where it runs an online retail operation under the name Rountree Outdoors. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business functions as an e‑commerce retailer specializing in hunting, fishing, and outdoor apparel. Its product assortment includes branded merchandise from Southern Marsh, Fish Hippie, Southern Point, Lews, Drake Waterfowl, and Strike King. Orders are fulfilled from its Selma location, with a stated policy of shipping within two business days using the United States Postal Service, UPS, or FedEx. The company emphasizes rapid order turnaround and a low free‑shipping threshold as its key differentiators, promoting assurance that items ship within two days of purchase and that shipping costs are waived on qualifying orders.

about:
Rowe Electronics operates from Norwalk, Iowa. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but its about page describes its origins as "humble beginnings" before becoming a supplier of remote control systems based on microprocessor technology.

The firm provides a range of engineering and manufacturing services centered on wire harnesses, electronic controls, and prototype development. Its capabilities span controls engineering, electronics engineering (including digital, analog, and power design), harness engineering (design, routing, packaging, testing, and delivery), and prototype engineering (concept validation, design reviews, test plans, and on‑site support). Rowe serves customers in agriculture, transportation, recreation, and industrial markets, with a primary focus on mobile equipment manufacturers. The company works with OEMs on projects ranging from accessory integration to complete machine solutions, and collaborates with client engineering teams on both turnkey and subset developments.

Rowe emphasizes a client‑first process that begins with understanding requirements and scales from small pilot projects to larger engagements. It differentiates itself through deep technical experience across the full electrical architecture, the ability to work within a client’s existing software and supply chain, and a prototyping approach that includes periodic design reviews and on‑site data collection.

name: Roy's Wood Products
old_description: We provide a full line of wood products and the industry’s best hardware and accessories: from custom cabinet doors and drawer fronts to dovetail drawer boxes, face frame material, hardwood plywood and mouldings, dimensional lumber, shutters, & more.
about:
Roy's Wood Products operates from Lugoff, South Carolina, where Roy Brazell Sr. founded the business in 1962 as a garage shop producing cabinet doors. The company remains family-owned, passing to his son Roy Brazell Jr. in 1985, who expanded the operation to 15,000 square feet. In 2000 the name changed to Roy's Wood Products, Inc., and in 2008 grandsons Jody and Russell Brazell acquired the business, continuing three generations of family leadership.

The firm manufactures a full line of wood components including custom cabinet doors, drawer fronts, dovetail drawer boxes, face frames, hardwood plywood, mouldings, dimensional lumber, and shutters, alongside a range of hardware and accessories. Production takes place in a facility exceeding 61,000 square feet that houses a rough mill and a dedicated cabinet door manufacturing plant, supported by experienced craftsmen and modern equipment.

Its customers span cabinet shops, millwork operations, and building professionals who source both stock and custom wood products for residential and commercial projects. The company supplies both standard and made-to-order items to meet varied project requirements.

The company emphasizes an old-fashioned focus on excellence at a reasonable price, a principle carried through three generations of the Brazell family and reflected in its commitment to quality products and dependable service.

name: Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC
old_description: Founded by Matt Ruben in 2018, Ruben Custom Sawmill began with a single sawmill and a bold vision: reclaim Minnesota's fallen trees and turn them into lasting works of art. What started as a weekend passion is now a full-time, family-run business trusted by clients across the Twin Cities.
about:
Ruben Custom Sawmill and Woodworks, LLC operates from White Bear Township, Minnesota, in the Twin Cities metro area. The company was founded in 2018 by Matt Ruben, who began with a single portable sawmill and a vision to reclaim fallen Minnesota trees and transform them into lasting works of art. What started as a weekend passion has grown into a full-time, family-run business serving clients across the region.

The shop produces custom furniture including live-edge tables, bar tops, and mantles, as well as butcher-block-style walnut countertops. In addition to finished pieces, Ruben Custom Sawmill offers portable on-site milling services, bringing a Wood-Mizer sawmill directly to a client's property to process logs into kiln-dried slabs and native hardwood lumber available by appointment. The company reports having salvaged over 1,000 trees and completed projects for more than 1,000 clients.

Customers are primarily residential homeowners and DIY enthusiasts in the Twin Cities area who seek one-of-a-kind furniture or need logs milled from their own land. Testimonials reference projects such as a custom black walnut mantel fitted over an existing stone surround, a dining table built from a client's own cherry and burr oak logs, and a coffee table crafted from supplied slabs. The business also works with contractors and designers on custom countertop installations.

Ruben emphasizes care, craftsmanship, and character in every job, whether milling on a client's property or building a dining table in the shop. The founder's original mission — giving fallen trees a second life — remains the guiding principle, and the portable milling capability allows customers to preserve trees that hold personal significance.

about:
Rustic Log Furniture of Utah, Inc. is based in Orem, Utah. The company was founded in the summer of 1997 by Randy Jackson, who began producing log porch swings. In early 1998, his brother Rodney Jackson joined the venture, and the operation expanded from a single product to a full line of log furniture and cabin decor. The business remains family-owned, now involving multiple members of the Jackson family.

The company manufactures log furniture and related cabin-style products, offering well over a thousand distinct items across categories such as bedroom, dining, living room, office, outdoor, bars and game room, cabinets, accessories, and décor. In addition to log furniture, they produce complementary lines including bedding, metal works, wood carvings and burnings, photography, and metal and antler chandeliers. They maintain in-stock inventory for quick fulfillment and also accept custom-built orders. Products are shipped throughout the United States, Canada, and Europe.

Rustic Log Furniture serves residential customers as well as commercial and entertainment clients. Their furniture has been installed in professional establishments such as the Community Center in Cedar Hills, Utah, and Vacation Marriott properties in Park City, Utah, and South Lake Tahoe. Hollywood productions have used their pieces, including Warner Brothers' film "Unaccompanied Minors" and Paramount's series "Yellowstone." Theatrical venues such as the Hale Center Theater in Orem have also featured their products.

The company emphasizes unique designs, a large selection, continuous product improvement, and competitive pricing. They highlight personalized, honest customer service and a commitment to long-term relationships beyond the initial sale. Environmental responsibility is also cited as a core value, with ongoing efforts to reduce waste and preserve natural resources.
